name: Arcones (Spain)
description: Square green flag with a white stripe of one quarter along the hoist, charged at the centre of the green with the crowned municipal arms of Arcones (funerary chests on green and chequy of blue and white).
history: Arcones adopted its arms and flag officially on 23 February 2001, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 10 May 2001; the flag is a square cloth of proportion 1/1 with a white vertical stripe at the hoist edge of a width of 1/4 of the total, the rest green with the arms of the town council superimposed at the centre.

features.role: Arcones arms — funerary chests on green and chequy of blue and white
